records.name: Bok choy, raw

verified_fields.description: White to pale green stems and rounded dark-green leaves

data_lineage_observations: Nutrient data combine multiple sample sets / references from 1997, 2001, 2005 and 2021.
Tryptophan is imputed from savoy cabbage.
The record marks alcohol, selected vitamins, cholesterol, fatty acids and caffeine as imputed zero; this must not be conflated with a missing value or an analytical zero.
records.decision: Best current candidate for a clearly labelled raw bok choy per-100-g reference, not an admitted application source and not a cooked-portion conversion basis.
